notes: Company overview: large programmatic ad platform with strict millisecond latency targets for real-time bidding (RTB). Currently running a mix of self-hosted Triton endpoints and cloud APIs; evaluating Redwood Dedicated to consolidate inference and get predictable unit economics.

Key asks: sustained throughput guarantees (50k reqs/sec across model ensemble during peak), 95th/99th latency SLOs (p95 < 20ms for short context scoring), clear reserved‑GPU planning for seasonal traffic spikes. Wants per-route quotas and traffic shaping to prioritize auction scoring over lower-priority personalization jobs.

Traffic shaping / priority lanes: Meridian needs tenant isolation inside Dedicated pool (logical lanes), ability to set per-route token/req quotas, and automatic fallback to lower-cost model variants when dedicated capacity is saturated. Also require enforced priority queues so auction scorer work preempts batch offline personalization runs.

Noisy-neighbor controls: urgent ask to prove isolation — expects hard SLOs for critical routes and mitigation mechanisms: preemptive eviction of low-priority batches, token/cost throttles, and real-time backpressure signals. Wants SLA language that ties model-level latency/throughput to credits/penalties.

Reserved GPU planning: asked for a capacity plan mapping 8xA100 equiv to expected qps across their ensemble (scoring + rerank). Requested sample autoscale + burst policy that guarantees headroom for 10% sudden load spike for 30 minutes without manual intervention.

Security/compliance: VPC peering + customer-managed KMS mandatory. Data residency for EU users (must route EU traffic to eu-dedicated cluster). SOC2 plus audit log retention of 12 months required for procurement.

Pricing / contract: procurement pushing for 12‑18 month reserved commitment with quarterly release windows on burst capacity. They requested Redwood term sheet with explicit SLA credits tied to p99/p95 latency breaches for critical routes.
Quote from CTO (call 2025-01-15): "If we can't guarantee scorer latency under 25ms p95 during auctions, we lose revenue—need solid isolation and a clear escalation path."

Internal notes (AE/SE): run an additional noisy-neighbor POC with dedicated isolation lanes enabled; capture metrics for preemption latency and cold-start bump. Priya to draft priority-lane config examples and a deterministic eviction policy doc.
